title: 9.2 Tangent Lines; Arc Length

icans: I can find dy/dx for a parametric curve.
I can find where the tangent line is horizontal or vertical.
I can find d²y/dx² and the arc length of a parametric curve.

vocab: the slope of a parametric __________: dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt)
the length of a parametric __________: L = ∫ √((dx/dt)² + (dy/dt)²) dt
